note: IFHA jointly presents Group/Graded quality-race categories; Group race and Grade race are corresponding system labels, not globally interchangeable headwords.
IFHA explicitly pairs Group 1 with Grade 1 as G1 quality-race descriptions across authorities.
IFHA explicitly pairs Group 2 with Grade 2 as G2 quality-race descriptions across authorities.
IFHA explicitly pairs Group 3 with Grade 3 as G3 quality-race descriptions across authorities.

Going and Track condition both describe racing-surface state but the official taxonomies differ across GB/IRE, North America, Japan and Australia; keep separate and related rather than exact-equivalent or narrower/broader globally.
Racecourse and Racetrack can refer to the overall racing venue, while Racetrack also has a documented physical-surface sense. Exact global equivalence is unsafe.
Track can denote a venue/listing entity with address and racing dates, but also denotes physical track/surface in other contexts. Preserve polysemy rather than merge.
Track and Course overlap when referring to the physical route or racing surface but neither is globally identical across all racing contexts.
A Fixture is an officially scheduled racing unit in the BHA fixture list; a Race meeting is the racing event/collection of races. Scheduling relation does not prove identity.
Race day describes the day or day's racing; Race meeting describes the event/collection. They often coincide but are not universally the same Concept.

scope: AUS/NZ deliberate spell within broader layoff/break concept
note: Spell/Spelling is a deliberate regional break from racing/training and therefore a narrower rest concept than generic Layoff. Do not universalize Racing Victoria's 60-day threshold.
Favorite and Longshot occupy contrasting market-support/price positions; this is a contrast relation, not a strict logical antonym claim.
France Galop Meeting is a series of Réunions; MEET-001 represents the one-day Réunion sense. They are structurally related but not synonyms.
Réunion Premium is a France-specific subtype/classification of a one-day Réunion/Race meeting.
Réunion PMH is a France-specific subtype/classification of a one-day Réunion/Race meeting.

scope: Tactical pacemaker role vs generic pacesetter
note: A tactical pacemaker intentionally makes the pace to benefit another aligned runner; every tactical pacemaker is pace-making, but a generic Pacesetter need not have that purpose.

scope: Actual race start vs scheduled start reference
note: Off time is an actual race-start timestamp while Scheduled start time/scheduled off time is the pre-announced reference. They are paired operational fields, not synonyms.

scope: Horse wet-track aptitude vs track-condition state
note: Wet-track aptitude describes a horse characteristic; Track condition describes the surface state. Mudlark must not be modeled as a condition label.
Travelling easily and Under pressure are contrasting race-commentary states. Regional labels include under double wraps/on the bit versus off the bit.
Dominant betting concentration is a more specific market state than generic strong betting support; 一本かぶり and backed off the map therefore remain distinct regional labels on related Concepts.
